question.prompt: If \(\angle\alpha=\angle\beta\) and \(\angle\alpha=55^\circ\), how many degrees is the complement of \(\angle\beta\)?

solutions.explanation: \(\angle\beta=\angle\alpha=55^\circ\), so its complement measures \(90^\circ-55^\circ=35^\circ\) (that is, complements of equal angles are equal).
solutions.title: Use the equal angle measure
